title: Massively parallel and time-resolved RNA sequencing in single cells with scNT-Seq
protocol: Culture K562 cells at 37°C in RPMI media supplemented with 10% FBS and 1% P/S until approximately 50% confluence.
Dissolve powder in DMSO to make a 1 M 4-thiouridine (4sU) stock.
Replace medium with fresh medium supplemented with non-toxic concentrations of 4sU, such as 200 μM for mESCs.
Remove media at the time-points of interest.
Prepare cell suspension or cryo-preserve cells by methanol fixation if required.
Fix cells in 80% methanol drop-wise while gently stirring the cell suspension with the tip of a P1000 pipette.
Gently invert tubes about 5 times to mix, then place on ice for more than 30 minutes.
Store fixed samples at -80°C for up to one month.
Rehydrate cells by spinning down at 800x g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Remove methanol-PBS solution carefully without disturbing the pellet.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 ml of DPBS-0.01% BSA with RNase inhibitor.
Count the resuspended cells using Countess II.
Dilute the counted cells to a concentration of 100 cells/μL in either DPBS-0.01% BSA or SSC cocktail.
Proceed to capture new and old RNAs on barcoded beads according to standard Drop-Seq protocol.
Treat barcoded beads with TimeLapse-Seq chemistry after droplet breakage to convert 4sU to cytidine analog in new RNAs.
Wash beads once with washing buffer (1 mM EDTA, 100 mM sodium acetate, pH 5.2).
Resuspend beads in a mixture of TFEA (600 mM), EDTA (1 mM), and sodium acetate (pH 5.2, 100 mM) in water.
Add NaIO4 solution to reach a final concentration of 10 mM and incubate at 45°C for 1 hour with rotation.
Wash beads once with 1 ml TE buffer.
Incubate beads in 0.5 mL Reducing Buffer (10 mM DTT, 100 mM NaCl, 10 mM Tris pH 7.4, 1 mM EDTA) at 37°C for 30 minutes with rotation.
Wash beads once more with 0.3 ml of 2X RT-buffer.
Perform reverse transcription and downstream library preparation steps as previously described in Drop-Seq.
Determine the optimal number of PCR cycles with an aliquot of 6,000 beads.
Prepare PCR reactions with the rest of barcoded beads collected for each scNT-Seq run.
Add 6,000 beads per PCR tube and run the TSO-PCR program to enrich cDNA.
Tagment cDNA using the Nextera XT DNA sample preparation kit from Illumina.
Start tagmentation with 550-1,000 pg of cDNA pooled from all PCR reactions for a given run.
Amplify the library further with 12 enrichment cycles using the Illumina Nextera XT i7 primers and P5-TSO hybrid primer.
Conduct quality control analysis using a Bioanalyzer (Agilent).
Load libraries at 2.0 pM on an Illumina NextSeq 500 instrument.
Add Custom Read1 Primer at 0.3 μM to position 7 of the reagent cartridge for sequencing.
Perform paired-end sequencing on Illumina NextSeq 500 sequencer with a configuration of 20 bp (Read1), 8 bp (Index1), and 60 bp (Read2).
